name: icod.ai
description: From prompt to live production. Turn Claude into your development agent by sending optimised instructions straight to icōd.ai to build and update apps instantly.

_published_faq.name: How do I add icod.ai to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add icod.ai to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.icod.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the icod.ai MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: icod.ai lists 13 MCP tools, including get_icod_instructions, icod_codegen_create, icod_codegen_read, icod_codegen_update, icod_deployment_create, icod_deployment_delete, icod_deployment_read, icod_deployment_update, icod_projects_create, icod_projects_delete, icod_projects_read, and icod_projects_update.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to icod.ai?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to icod.ai in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
icod.ai requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
icod.ai is developed by icod.ai LLC. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
